# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c15 P12](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0012)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

She is described as heavy and stout, a contrast to the slimmer girls in her class.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie has a spiteful, sarcastic, and dishonest nature, possessing what is described as the most caustic tongue at Regent's Academy. She frequently grins spitefully, boasts about her achievements, and mocks others—particularly Nell Harcourt about her red hair and plain looks. Despite her competitive and proud disposition, she is quick to harbor resentment, hold grudges, and engage in petty gossip, though she can be unnerved when faced with serious consequences or guilt.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P14](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0014), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c27 P31](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0031), [v1 c27 P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040)_

## History

Flossie Tulk attended Brierley School as a member of the Fourth and later Fifth class, where she was known for her spiteful behavior and her rivalry with other pupils, particularly Nell Harcourt and Julia Bell. During Sunday-school and regular classes, she frequently mocked Nell and engaged in dishonest practices like peeking at her textbook during spelling. When Nell was punished by being forced to stand on the dais or sit next to Hugh Carrow, Flossie reacted with spiteful grins. She participated in the Brierley Sunday-school picnic and later joined the class in welcoming the new teacher, Miss Agnes Thorne. When the students formed the Regent's Academy preparatory class under Miss Thorne, Flossie joined despite complaining about the workload and expressing vanity about her family's wealth, claiming she did not need a license to earn a living. During a party at the Pembroke home, Flossie challenged Nell to walk the ridgepole of a kitchen roof; when Nell fell and was injured, Flossie was terrified by thoughts of guilt until Nell recovered. Later, Flossie attended Regent's Academy in Port Marlow along with her classmates, residing in the same boarding house as Frank Stockley. At the Academy, she developed a reputation for having a caustic tongue and continued her petty rivalries, such as falling out with Julia Bell for three months after making rude comments about her. She completed the Second Class coursework and returned to Regent's for a second year.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P30](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0030), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c34 P20](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0020)_
